note: Re-judged 2026-10-24 (independent auditor, authored none of the change). RFC 7432 Section 8.1.1: "The Ethernet Segment Identifier (ESI) MUST be set to the 10-octet value described in Section 5." 238bdb62e9 unexported the EVPN route types; TestEVPNESIIsTenOctets now asserts the parsed type is *evpnType4 where it asserted *EVPNType4, the same type renamed. The ten-octet ESI length and value assertions are unchanged. Verdict unchanged: enforced. Earlier judgement follows. row now quotes the §8.1.1 sentence that the ESI MUST be the 10-octet value of §5 (the extraction maps 8.1.1:2 here). types_test.go::TestEVPNESIIsTenOctets decodes and re-encodes a 10-octet ESI on the Ethernet Segment and Ethernet A-D routes and asserts the following field starts after octet ten; the negatives cut the ESI to nine octets and assert ErrEVPNTruncated. ESI is a [10]byte, so no origination path can produce another width
